borders.radius: rounded-2xl for cards, rounded-xl for inputs/buttons, rounded-full for pills

grids_layouts.sidebar: w-64 flex-shrink-0 border-r border-stone-200 bg-white hidden md:flex flex-col
grids_layouts.top_nav: md:hidden h-16 border-b border-stone-200 bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-xl sticky top-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-between px-4

components.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full) or smooth rounded (rounded-xl). Primary CTA must be Emerald. Use inline transitions.
components.cards: bg-white border border-stone-200 rounded-2xl p-6 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow duration-200. Left-align text.
components.checkboxes: Large, satisfying to click. Use emerald color when checked. Focus ring should be emerald.
components.inputs: Shadcn-based, rounded-xl, bg-stone-50/50 border-stone-200 focus:border-emerald-500 focus:ring-emerald-500/20.
components.tags: Small pill-shaped spans for 'Shared' and 'Private'. uppercase tracking-wider text-xs px-3 py-1 rounded-full font-medium border

motion.hover: Subtle translate-y-[-2px] for cards, scale-95 on active for buttons.
motion.transitions: Always specific properties (e.g., transition-colors, transition-transform) with duration-200 ease-out.

accessibility.focus: All interactive elements must have focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-emerald-500 focus-visible:ring-offset-2
accessibility.contrast: Ensure text-stone-500 or lighter passes APCA contrast ratios against bg-stone-50.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Never use `transition: all`. Specify exact properties (e.g., `transition-colors duration-200`).
Do NOT center align the app container (`.App { text-align: center; }` is forbidden).
Use 2-3x more spacing (e.g., p-6 or p-8 instead of p-4) to make the UI breathe.
Never use purely transparent backgrounds on sticky headers or overlays. Use bg-white/80 with backdrop-blur-xl.
Add `data-testid` to all interactive and key informational elements based on the data_testid_conventions above.
DO NOT add any functions outside of what was requested (keep it simple).
Buttons should have clear active and hover states (e.g., hover:bg-emerald-700 active:scale-95).
Ensure the Habit details page accurately shows the 7-day checkboxes labeled with dates (YYYY-MM-DD).
